source.citation: Maalej, Y., Dormieux, L., Sanahuja, J. (2009). Micromechanical approach to the failure criterion of granular media. European Journal of Mechanics A/Solids 28, 647-653.

transcription.from: the published article (PDF), Section 6 and Eq. (65), p. 653, read on the page text
transcription.note: The same two fitted values drive the Echoes example criterion_granular.py.

friction_coefficient.description: Intergranular friction coefficient alpha of the Mohr-Coulomb interface law |T_t| <= -alpha T_n, fitted by the authors to the macroscopic slope of sands, for both the ductile and the brittle model.

stiffness_ratio_brittle.description: Ratio rho = K_t / K_n of the tangential to the normal stiffness of the contacts in the brittle model, fitted by the authors.

caquot_kerisel_coefficient.description: Coefficient of the empirical rule tan(phi_f) = 0.55 (1 - phi) / phi of Caquot and Kérisel (1956) for uniform rough sands, phi_f the friction angle and phi the porosity, as quoted by the authors.

notes: Caquot and Kérisel (1956), Traité de Mécanique des Sols (Gauthier-Villars), is cited through this article; the book itself was not consulted.
